name: Build One Useful Workflow
objective: Help participants reproduce a useful product workflow and identify its limits in a one-hour broadcast.
audience: Developers and technical customer teams joining remotely
constraints: Fictional planning example; studio, crew, and participants are unverified.
Provide live captions, accessible replay, and a text version of the workflow.
The public broadcast runs 10:00–11:00 local; office hours are optional.
Use opt-in follow-through and a prepared offline demo recording.
